proposed.text: What does the Table 424.2.2 note say about ponding on flat roofs?

options.text: Ponding must be checked by deflection calculations including added deflections due to ponded water and time-dependent effects.
The table limit automatically safeguards against all ponding.
Ponding is checked only by occupancy category.
Ponding is ignored if the roof is concrete.

rationale.correct: The note says the limit is not intended to safeguard against ponding and that ponding must be checked by calculations including ponded-water and time-dependent effects.
rationale.takeaway: A deflection table limit does not replace a ponding check.
